name: 紙飛機穿城
description: 一架藍色紙飛機穿過紙摺的城市，屋頂摺成小金字塔、紙電車在高架單軌上擦身而過；時而俯衝進街谷，鏡頭在跟拍、大俯視、第一人稱之間輪替，永遠飛不完。
description_en: A blue paper plane glides through an endless folded-paper city, past pyramid-folded rooftops and a paper monorail train. It dives into the street canyons now and then, and the camera cycles between chase, overhead and first-person views.
